english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for predicting an outcome from available information.

exampleSentences.english: I predict it will rain tomorrow.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 gai3 teng1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

english.note: Use this when emphasizing a rough numerical calculation or forecast from incomplete data.

exampleSentences.english: I estimate that it will rain tomorrow.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5
